import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Package, Calendar, TrendingUp, FileText, Plus, Search, Filter } from 'lucide-react'; const PurchaseOrders = ({ businessId }) => { const [purchaseOrders, setPurchaseOrders] = useState([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [showCreateModal, setShowCreateModal] = useState(false); const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(''); const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('all'); useEffect(() => { loadPurchaseOrders(); }, [businessId]); const loadPurchaseOrders = async () => { setLoading(true); // Mock data for now - will connect to Supabase const mockPOs = [ { id: 1, po_number: 'PO-2024-001', customer_name: 'Enterprise Corp', project_name: 'Website Redesign', amount: 15000.00, created_date: '2024-01-10', status: 'active', invoiced_amount: 5000.00, remaining_amount: 10000.00 }, { id: 2, po_number: 'PO-2024-002', customer_name: 'Tech Startup Inc', project_name: 'Mobile App Development', amount: 25000.00, created_date: '2024-01-12', status: 'active', invoiced_amount: 10000.00, remaining_amount: 15000.00 }, { id: 3, po_number: 'PO-2024-003', customer_name: 'Global Solutions', project_name: 'API Integration', amount: 8000.00, created_date: '2024-01-05', status: 'completed', invoiced_amount: 8000.00, remaining_amount: 0 }, { id: 4, po_number: 'PO-2024-004', customer_name: 'Local Business LLC', project_name: 'SEO Optimization', amount: 3500.00, created_date: '2024-01-18', status: 'draft', invoiced_amount: 0, remaining_amount: 3500.00 } ]; setPurchaseOrders(mockPOs); setLoading(false); }; const getStatusColor = (status) => { switch (status) { case 'active': return 'bg-green-500 text-green-500'; case 'completed': return 'bg-blue-500 text-blue-500'; case 'draft': return 'bg-gray-500 text-gray-500'; case 'cancelled': return 'bg-red-500 text-red-500'; default: return 'bg-gray-500 text-gray-500'; } }; const filteredPOs = purchaseOrders.filter(po => { const matchesSearch = po.customer_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || po.project_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || po.po_number.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()); const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'all' || po.status === statusFilter; return matchesSearch && matchesStatus; }); const totalPOValue = purchaseOrders .filter(po => po.status === 'active' || po.status === 'completed') .reduce((sum, po) => sum + po.amount, 0); const totalInvoiced = purchaseOrders .reduce((sum, po) => sum + po.invoiced_amount, 0); const totalRemaining = purchaseOrders .filter(po => po.status === 'active') .reduce((sum, po) => sum + po.remaining_amount, 0);
